next_steps.action: Measure the controller's VIN pin (input supply to the high-side FET drain).

measure.where: Controller VIN pin (consult datasheet for pin number) or the high-side FET drain pad
measure.expected: Equals the upstream rail voltage (e.g. +5VALW = 5.0 V). Tolerance per upstream rail spec.
measure.safety: Probe carefully to avoid shorting adjacent pins. Use fine needle probes.

interpretations.if_result: VIN present and at expected voltage
interpretations.then: Input supply is good. Proceed to check controller VCC (logic supply).
Upstream rail is dead. Diagnose the upstream rail first (see its topology rules). Do NOT continue on this rail.
Upstream rail is out of regulation or loaded down. Diagnose upstream rail; possible short on a sibling rail sharing the same upstream supply.

next_steps.requires_info_note: Need the controller's datasheet to know which pin is VIN and what the expected voltage is. If the controller part number is unknown, identify it from the board marking first.
